title: Gallery- Photo Gallery & Album
summary: All in one gallery - Lock, clean, edit & organize photos and videos instantly.
description:
🏞️ Gallery- Photo Gallery & Album

Tired of switching between multiple apps to manage your photos?

Gallery- Photo Gallery & Album brings everything into one powerful gallery app.

It helps you organize, 🔒 protect, ✨ edit, and manage your photos and videos in one fast and secure place.

Gallery- Photo Gallery & Album is a modern photo gallery designed for people who want more control, better privacy, and smarter organisation without slowing down their phone ⚡.

If your current gallery feels basic or cluttered, it’s time to upgrade to a gallery app built for performance and simplicity 🚀.

No need for separate vault apps, cleaner apps, or photo editors — everything works together inside a single powerful gallery.


🔒 Private Photo Vault

Keep personal photos and videos safe with a secure vault.

Lock sensitive media using a PIN and protect your private moments from unwanted access. Your memories stay protected inside a secure vault designed for privacy.


🧹 Smart Cleaner for Your Media

Running out of storage?

Quickly remove duplicate photos, similar images, and large video files in just a few taps. Free up space and keep your photo collection organized. A clean library means faster browsing and smoother performance.


📸 Built-In Photo Editor

Edit your pictures directly inside the app.

Crop, rotate, adjust brightness and contrast, apply filters, and enhance your favorite shots instantly. No need to switch between apps — everything you need is already included.


📂 Organized Albums & Easy Browsing

Automatically sort your photos by date and folders.

Create custom albums, move images easily, and find any picture in seconds. Managing thousands of files becomes simple with a well-structured photo gallery layout.


🗺 Browse by Location

View your memories on a map and see where your photos were taken.

Location-based browsing adds a new way to explore your favorite trips and special moments.


✨ Automatic Memories

Relive your favorite moments from special days, trips, and important events.

Bring past moments back to life with beautifully grouped memories. Easily rediscover photos you may have forgotten.


🖼 Create Photo Collages

Turn multiple pictures into beautiful collages using ready-made layouts.

Share creative combinations of your best moments with friends and family.


📄 Extract Text from Images

Copy text directly from photos using the built-in scanner.

Capture notes, documents, or important information and convert images into usable text instantly.


🎥 Smooth Video Playback

Play videos seamlessly inside the gallery app.

Enjoy fast loading and smooth HD playback for all your recorded memories.


📸 Why Choose This Photo Gallery?

✔ Secure vault protection
✔ Smart cleaning tools
✔ Powerful editing features
✔ Organized albums and folders
✔ Map-based browsing
✔ Collage creator
✔ Text scanning from images
✔ Fast and lightweight performance
✔ Simple, modern interface

Gallery- Photo Gallery & Album is more than a basic phone gallery.

It’s an all-in-one solution that replaces your default photo gallery and eliminates the need for multiple photo apps.

It’s a complete media manager designed to keep your photos and videos organized, secure, and easy to access.


📥 Download Now

Download this secure photo gallery today and take full control of your memories with smarter tools, better privacy, and a smoother experience.
